Rule Finder

An old relay lets some things through its gate and stops the rest. Send it items of your own, then name the rule. Testing is free and nothing is timed.

Drawers

Every drawer and every case is open from the start: play any of them, in any order. A case is named when your rule agrees with the hidden one on every possible item.

Rule Codex

Achievements

Every one can be earned in any order, with no luck and no deadline, and each shows how close you are.
